title: OSS calls to grafana.com API reuse cfg.GrafanaComAPIURL / cfg.GrafanaComSSOAPIToken
answers: Which config settings should I use to call the grafana.com API from OSS code?
How is the gcom API URL/token configured for the router fallback?
body: Rather than introducing a new setting for gcom access, this PR reuses the existing `[grafana_com] api_url` / `sso_api_token` config (env `GF_GRAFANA_COM_API_URL` / `GF_GRAFANA_COM_SSO_API_TOKEN`), exposed as cfg.GrafanaComAPIURL / cfg.GrafanaComSSOAPIToken, matching enterprise's direct gcom instance client. The token is sent as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`; deployments must supply it for the fallback to work. The single-tenant fallback itself stays gated by `[cloud_router] st_discovery_url` (ProvideCloudRoutesLoaderFactory in pkg/router/cloud_router.go) — the gcom settings only take effect when that discovery URL is configured.
applies: pkg/router package and any OSS code needing to talk to the grafana.com instances API
